name: subtree_fingerprints

test_list.description: Fingerprinting the same source twice gives the same list.
Each fingerprint is the xxh3-64 of exactly the bytes of its span.
Editing one function changes only its fingerprint.
Shifting text moves spans but keeps fingerprints.
Duplicate functions share a fingerprint with distinct spans.
An impl block and each of its methods are fingerprinted.
Python, C++, CUDA and TypeScript produce one entry per declaration.
Property: exactly the edited function's fingerprint changes.

output_description: xxh3-64 per declaration node in source order (dirty-check only, never a security identity).
